programme: HAND2 (185/270) and SOX10 are the two transcription factors that build the enteric nervous system from vagal neural crest, and NEUROD1 with PLAG1 and CAMTA1 extends that into enteric neuronal and enteroendocrine differentiation. GLI3 supplies the Hedgehog input that patterns gut mesenchyme and neural crest migration; ESR1, PITX2, SOX5, HOXA5, NFIA and DMRT1 are peripheral.
role_in_a: The enteric nervous system is where Parkinsons disease is now thought to begin in a substantial fraction of patients: alpha-synuclein pathology appears in enteric neurons and the vagus, and gut-first disease with vagal spread is the leading model of prodromal Parkinsons. HAND2 and SOX10 are the factors that specify exactly those neurons and their glia.
role_in_b: Gastric tumours are supported by their innervation: vagal cholinergic input promotes gastric tumorigenesis and denervation suppresses it, and enteric neurons and glia are part of the tumour microenvironment that these factors report.
shared_axis: Both diseases involve the same vagal-neural-crest-derived enteric neuronal and glial compartment - the target tissue of early synucleinopathy and the tumour-promoting innervation of the stomach - with HAND2 and SOX10 as its identity factors.
reasoning: The enteric nervous system is separately and firmly implicated in each disease - gut-first Parkinsons on one side, nerve-dependent gastric tumorigenesis on the other - and the factors here are the ones that compartment is built from rather than a neural label. Support of 51-69 percent across 270 comparisons is reasonable. The reservation is that the Parkinsons measurements are in blood, so the enteric interpretation is inference from the factor identities rather than from the tissue sampled.
support: 31255487 — pathologic alpha-synuclein introduced into the gut spreads along the vagus to the brain, and truncal vagotomy prevents the spread; 25143365 — vagal denervation suppresses gastric tumorigenesis.
how_to_falsify: The Parkinsons measurements are blood, so the enteric reading is inferred from factor identity, not from the tissue sampled. If HAND2/SOX10 concordance in blood has a haematopoietic explanation, the story collapses.
caveats: Tissue pairing is blood | stomach. 270 patient-group combinations from 2 independent cohort pairs.
